brief.headline: Black Friday with nothing to discount: show real prices to the pound, say no countdown, and post NO-vember before it ends on Tuesday.
brief.summary: I found no bathroom-specific trend from the last 14 days. What is live are general formats from third-party trackers, and two of them are on a deadline: NO-vember ends on 1 December and "Add to Cart" fades after Cyber Monday. Today we use those for reach. We also post "When life gives you a £15,000 budget", one day old and our best brand fit, to turn saves into studio starts. Most competitors are leading Black Friday with discounts, so we stay calm and clear about price: exact figures with VAT, nothing ordered until you approve, and no sale language. Half of today's ideas go after reach and saves, and half point to one action: start a free 3D design.

# Research dossier: Bespoke Bathroom UK
**Date:** Friday 27 November 2026 (Black Friday). **Window:** today to Saturday 5 December 2026. **Focus:** balanced, half reach and saves, half studio starts.

**Before you read:** I found no bathroom or interiors trend on any platform with evidence from the last 14 days. The dated, current signals are general formats from third-party trend trackers (New Engen, SocialBee, Virlo), not from TikTok Creative Center or Instagram's own channels. Each idea below takes a live format and fills it with this brand's material. Treat momentum figures as third-party estimates.

---

## Trends

### 1. "It's NO-vember": the list of things to stop doing
- **Platforms:** Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook Reels
- **Kind:** Text-led format with a deadline
- **What it is:** Short "no" lines stacked under the month's name, each naming a habit to drop.
- **Evidence:** New Engen's weekly tracker, updated 20 November 2026, lists it. It says the pun "expires December 1". The audio is usually original and the text does the work, so business accounts can use it.
- **How we use it:** A Fitter's Eye piece. A slow push-in on a finished stone and brass wall while the lines land one at a time: "NO-vember. No grout lines that don't match the tile layout. No bath that arrives three weeks before the taps. No price that turns up after the work starts. No second brief for the fitter to get wrong." Last frame: "Start your design, free." This is the most urgent idea on the list: post today or tomorrow, because it dies on Tuesday.
- **Brand fit:** 82
- **Momentum:** Peaking, with a fixed end date
- **Lifespan:** About 3 days (ends 1 December)
- **Sources:** https://newengen.com/insights/instagram-trends/

### 2. "When life gives you…": a carousel that builds to a reveal
- **Platforms:** Instagram carousel, TikTok photo mode, Facebook
- **Kind:** Carousel format
- **What it is:** One element per slide, building to a surprise final slide.
- **Evidence:** SocialBee added it on 26 November 2026, so it is one day old. The suggested brand use is showing the ingredients first and the finished product last.
- **How we use it:** Material & Mood into Designed in 3D. "When life gives you a £15,000 budget…" Then one slide each for warm stone, gold finish, walnut vanity and tile quantities worked out, ending on the real studio render (£15,000, warm stone, gold). The caption asks people to save it. The CTA is "Set your own budget, free."
- **Brand fit:** 92
- **Momentum:** New and rising
- **Lifespan:** 2 to 3 weeks
- **Sources:** https://socialbee.com/blog/latest-instagram-trends/

### 3. "These can coexist btw" and "It's cool to do both": split-screen pairs
- **Platforms:** Instagram carousel and Reels, TikTok, Pinterest (as a two-panel pin)
- **Kind:** Split-screen or comparison format
- **What it is:** Two things people assume are in conflict, shown side by side.
- **Evidence:** SocialBee lists "These can coexist btw" on 26 November and "It's cool to do both" on 11 November 2026.
- **How we use it:** Small-space and price myths. "A small en-suite and a walk-in shower can coexist." "A fixed budget and a stone basin can coexist." "Seeing it in 3D and changing your mind can coexist (nothing is ordered until you approve)." Each pair ends on a studio render. This makes good saveable "this vs that" content for inspiration savers.
- **Brand fit:** 88
- **Momentum:** Rising
- **Lifespan:** 2 to 4 weeks
- **Sources:** https://socialbee.com/blog/latest-instagram-trends/

### 4. "Some bills are non-negotiable. The bills:"
- **Platforms:** Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook Reels
- **Kind:** Relatable list format
- **What it is:** Small luxuries people refuse to cut from their budget.
- **Evidence:** SocialBee added it on 11 November 2026 (16 days ago, just outside the 14-day line, but it sits with the 19 and 26 November entries and matches the Black Friday spending mood).
- **How we use it:** For wellness and spa seekers. "Some bills are non-negotiable. The bills:" over close-ups of a heated towel rail, a rain shower, a Dell round LED demister mirror (£263.84) and a warm stone basin. Each piece gets its price with VAT, priced to the pound. It answers Black Friday without discount language: the point is what's worth paying for, not what's cheap.
- **Brand fit:** 85
- **Momentum:** Holding
- **Lifespan:** 1 to 2 weeks
- **Sources:** https://socialbee.com/blog/latest-instagram-trends/

### 5. "Add to Cart": Black Friday's shopping format
- **Platforms:** Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook Reels
- **Kind:** Seasonal shopping format
- **What it is:** Hands bring products into frame, and each one gets an "add to cart" reaction.
- **Evidence:** New Engen named it the top November pick on 6 November and still listed it on 20 November 2026. It says the format "showed up across several November trend roundups". Original audio or a voiceover saying "add to cart" works for business accounts.
- **How we use it:** Guess the Price meets Shop the Look. Gloved hands bring each piece of a room into frame: the vanity, the basin, the mixer, the mirror. A small running total in Inter, cream on navy, updates to the pound with VAT. The last beat: "Or skip the cart. Design the whole room around your budget, free." It suits today because shoppers are in cart mode, but it never says "sale".
- **Brand fit:** 78
- **Momentum:** Peaking (it lasts while Black Friday and Cyber Monday run)
- **Lifespan:** Until about 30 November, then the "gift guide" version runs into December
- **Sources:** https://newengen.com/insights/instagram-trends/

### 6. "Born to… forced to…"
- **Platforms:** TikTok, Instagram Reels
- **Kind:** Contrast and humour format
- **What it is:** What you love doing set against the daily reality.
- **Evidence:** SocialBee added it on 19 November 2026.
- **How we use it:** The Bath Arrived Three Weeks Before the Taps series. "Born to soak in a freestanding bath. Forced to share one shower with three teenagers." Or for trade: "Born to fit bathrooms. Forced to chase four deliveries for one job." Use illustration, b-roll or a team member, never a customer's home. End with "One order. One delivery plan."
- **Brand fit:** 74
- **Momentum:** Rising
- **Lifespan:** 2 to 3 weeks
- **Sources:** https://socialbee.com/blog/latest-instagram-trends/

### 7. Year-end recaps ("I feel like I haven't done much this year", Wrapped season)
- **Platforms:** Instagram Reels and carousel, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube Shorts
- **Kind:** Seasonal recap format
- **What it is:** A quiet opener, then one clip per month.
- **Evidence:** New Engen listed it on 20 November 2026. Spotify Wrapped is predicted (not confirmed) for Wednesday 2 December 2026, and its launch usually sets off brand recaps.
- **How we use it:** "Our 2026, designed." One studio render or fitted room per month. A carousel version: "Studio Wrapped: the most-picked style, the most-picked metal finish, the most common budget." **Only use real counts.** Leave placeholders such as [ADD: most-chosen style from studio data] rather than guessing. The trend's usual audio (Harry Styles, "Coming Up Roses") is licensed music, so business accounts should use original audio or a voiceover.
- **Brand fit:** 72 (rises to 85 if the studio data is available)
- **Momentum:** Rising into December
- **Lifespan:** To about 31 December
- **Sources:** https://newengen.com/insights/instagram-trends/ ; https://www.officialcharts.com/chart-news/spotify-wrapped-2026-release-date/

### 8. Christmas wrapping-paper reveal
- **Platforms:** Instagram Reels and Stories, TikTok, Facebook
- **Kind:** Seasonal reveal format
- **What it is:** Paper covers the frame and is torn open to reveal a product, offer or date.
- **Evidence:** New Engen listed it on 20 November 2026. No set sound, so original audio or paper sounds are safe.
- **How we use it:** Do it the calm way. Use cream paper with a gold edge, a slow tear and a real paper sound, then reveal a Screen to Room or render. Line: "The gift that takes a weekend to plan: a bathroom designed before the new year." Avoid red-and-green clutter. It works best from Advent Sunday (29 November) onwards.
- **Brand fit:** 66
- **Momentum:** Rising
- **Lifespan:** To about 24 December
- **Sources:** https://newengen.com/insights/instagram-trends/

### Aesthetic signals (useful, but not trends under the 14-day rule)
- **Warm textures and bathrooms that feel like rooms:** Homes & Gardens UK, 23 October 2026. It names bold material pairings ("something small and glossy with a large, dramatic slab of stone"), design-led brassware and personalised tile layouts. Ideal Home (6 August 2026) says sky blue, pattern play and "bathrooms that don't feel like bathrooms" will carry into 2027. These suit the Spanish to Japanese and One Piece, Three Rooms series.
- **Dulux Colour of the Year 2027, Soulful Sage:** announced 8 September 2026. Good for a Material & Mood carousel: sage with warm stone, walnut and brushed gold.
- **Ignore:** "0 to 100 loading transformation" is marked fading by Virlo. "He wanna pay full price SNL" is rising on TikTok, but no tracker explains the format and it uses SNL broadcast audio, so it carries a licensing risk.

---

## Moments in the window (dated)

| Date | Moment | How to use it |
|---|---|---|
| Fri 27 Nov | Black Friday | Run trends 4 and 5. Message: honest prices, no sale language. |
| Sat 28 Nov | US Small Business Saturday (not the UK date) | Ignore. |
| Sun 29 Nov | Advent Sunday (calendar date) | Start the wrapping-paper reveal and "plan it before the new year" messages. |
| Mon 30 Nov | Cyber Monday; St Andrew's Day | Final "Add to Cart" push. Last day for NO-vember. A Scottish nod only if the fitting team covers Scotland [ADD: service area]. |
| Tue 1 Dec | NO-vember ends; Advent calendars start | Switch to December formats. A 24-day "one detail a day" Stories series is an option. |
| Wed 2 Dec | Spotify Wrapped (predicted, not confirmed) | Post "Our 2026, designed" within 24 hours of launch. |
| Thu 3 Dec | Pantone Colour of the Year 2027 public event in Miami (reveal date not confirmed) | Be ready with a "Pantone in a bathroom" studio render the day it's revealed. |

| Weather | No current Met Office forecast found for this week; the latest evidence is from mid-November | Check the Met Office on the day. A cold snap would justify a heating and towel-rail post. |

---

## What is working for comparable brands
I couldn't find evidence from the last 14 days of specific high-performing posts from Victorian Plumbing, C.P. Hart, Drench, Lusso or the other competitors, so I'm not reporting any. What the research does show:
- **Black Friday is mostly discount-led.** Victorian Plumbing, Drench and Sanctuary run Black Friday pages, but those I could see were labelled 2025 or carried over. Doors 2 Floors ran its first Black Friday campaign, and its MD said renovation plans are being scaled back because of price rises. This leaves room for a calm, price-transparent voice.
- **Small shops on TikTok:** Virlo's 24 November note covers three viral selling formats small shops use, including product demos and packing orders. Our version is delivery day and the "one delivery plan" story.
- **Price-led framing outperforms:** Virlo's 26 November note found a $20 meal plating got 4.5M views while the same creator's $12 meal got 75K. It's outside our category, but it supports showing exact prices on screen.
- **Platform direction:** MEAN CEO's November guide (secondary source) favours search-friendly Reels, saveable carousels and DM-based conversion. That supports comment-to-DM and keyword-led on-screen text.
- **Bathroom TikTok in general:** DIY fails and mismatched-tile reveals keep resurfacing, but the examples I found were from 2023 to 2025. We can use the pain in our own story, but we should never mock a real person.

---

## Lead-gen angles
1. **The expectation gap (Know Before You Renovate):** A Federation of Master Builders survey (reported 28 April 2026) found 71% of homeowners expect a bathroom renovation to cost under £10,000, and only 38% knew labour is the most expensive part. Its chief executive said: "Most homeowners are budgeting for the bathroom they imagine, not the bathroom they'll actually get." Hook: "You're budgeting for the bathroom you imagine." Then the Budget Ladder, ending with "See yours priced to the pound, free." Cite the FMB on screen.
2. **Black Friday without a discount:** "No countdown. No 'from' prices. Just your room, priced to the pound, before you pay anything." Link to the studio.
3. **"When life gives you £X" (trend 2):** Add a comment-to-DM: comment PLAN to get the planning checklist.
4. **Facebook lead form for January planners:** Older, local homeowners plan over the holidays. Offer "Talk to a designer" and the [COST] budget-tiers guide. Wait until the service area is filled in before targeting locally.
5. **Your Bathroom, Redesigned, festive edition:** "Send us your bathroom before Christmas, we'll redesign it on camera." Use the comment DESIGN mechanic, and get written permission before showing any home.

---

## Watch-outs
- **Audio:** Commercial tracks linked to these trends (Harry Styles, Wham!'s "Last Christmas", the Finneas "My Moon My Man" cover, the SNL clip) are not safe for business accounts. Use original audio, voiceover, real sounds (water, paper, brass) or Meta's licensed library, and check in the app before posting.
- **Price mismatch to resolve:** The six hero products add up to £12,495.84. The Brand Brain says the six-piece "shop the look" room totals £11,533.84, so the hero list and that room are not the same six pieces. Check which six make up £11,533.84 before showing a running total.
- **Recap data:** Every studio count needs real figures. Use [ADD:] placeholders until they arrive.
- **Black Friday tone:** Avoid "deal", "sale", "save" and "cheap", and don't name or knock competitors.
- **Consent:** Never show a customer's face or home without written permission. Use renders, studio b-roll or team members.
- **Timings:** Don't promise "fitted before Christmas" or any lead time. The designer confirms stock and lead times per design.
- **Third-party data:** Every trend here comes from aggregators. Check the format is still live in the Reels and TikTok apps on the day you post.
- **Proof gaps:** There are still no reviews, accreditations or service area in the Brand Brain. Trust content should wait for those.
